Context

The collection tests one identity across merchandise, signage and a vehicle.

Visual direction

A dark wordmark and red circular motif repeat across white and black surfaces.

Design decisions

The red shape supplies a recognisable graphic element on the banner and van. Smaller applications keep the wordmark clear without needing the full composition.

Applications

Seven presentations cover an overview, shirt, tote, notebook, lanyard, banner and van.
